_comment: Best-effort USD estimates for cost tracking ONLY, never authoritative billing. Token models use inputPer1M/outputPer1M. imageModels and documentModels use the explicit billing basis shown. Any absent model or unsupported option records cost as unknown rather than zero.
_source: Azure Retail Prices API (https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices, 2023-01-01-preview) for Azure BFL Flux Models, Azure Mistral Models Global Standard meters, and Azure Content Understanding document/contextualization meters. GPT-6 Astra uses Microsoft's official Global Standard short-context launch pricing (https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/gpt-6-astra-frontier-intelligence-for-work-now-generally-available-in-microsoft-foundry/), verified 2026-09-06 while its retail meters await publication. MAI-Thinking-1 comes from the official Azure MAI registry asset. Claude comes from Anthropic's official Microsoft Foundry pricing documentation.
_caveats: Flat rates cannot express every meter dimension. Long-context, cache, priority, Data Zone, regional, batch, reference-image, annotation, and provisioned variants may differ. Astra's Global Standard long-context rates are $20 input/$75 output per million tokens rather than the short-context $10/$50 estimate recorded here. FLUX.2 estimates use output megapixels; FLUX.1 uses one image. MAI-Image-2.5/Pro/Flash, MAI-Image-2.6/Flash, gpt-image-2, and gpt-image-1-mini remain cost-unknown because no unambiguous Azure retail meter is published. Mistral OCR 4 annotation pricing is excluded because this app requests OCR only. Content Understanding page meters are recorded separately by minimal/basic/standard usage; standard versus advanced contextualization is taken from the service's own contextualizationTokens and advancedContextualizationTokens usage properties, never from a locally authored analyzer label.
